messages.text: Open the failed Harbor & Vale run and explain the error.

The Development run failed because its payload set `quantityOverride` to `-2` for HV-104. The error says valid values are integers from 1–100 and the source quantity is `2`, so the override must be removed or changed to `2`.
Fix it using the source quantity and verify the new result.
I’m replaying harbor-order-summary in Development with HV-104’s source quantity of 2.

The corrected Development replay completed as run `run_06gcevgt220c3vb87n2s8sqr01`. With HV-104’s override set to its source quantity `2`, it returned 5 paid orders, 10 units, and INR 19,390: North 8,497, South 3,499, West 7,394.
